question: Which film won the Golden Peacock Award for Best Feature Film at the 56th International Film Festival of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Skin of Youth.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7a63139f3b57ffe3814d27f8dcaee8cb420142f7146b480d479d526074519671.png] **__In News__** 

__
 
• The 56th International Film Festival of India concluded in Goa, where the Vietnamese film **Skin of Youth** won the prestigious Golden Peacock for Best Feature Film.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **Key Points__** 

__
 
• **Skin of Youth**, directed by Ashleigh Mayfair, received the **Golden Peacock**, the highest honour of the festival.
 
• The award recognises excellence in global cinema, highlighting impactful storytelling and artistic merit.
 
• The film stood out among international entries, showcasing the rising strength of Vietnamese cinema.
 
• Its win reflects IFFI’s commitment to celebrating diverse voices, cultures and cinematic innovation.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

__
 
• **Other Major Awards at IFFI 56**__

 __
 
• **Best Director:** Santosh Davakhar (Gondhal – Marathi)
 
• **Best Male Actor:** Ubeimar Rios (A Poet – Spanish film)
 
• **Best Female Actor:** Jara Sofija Ostan (Little Trouble Girls – Slovenian film)
 
• **Best Debut Feature Film (Joint Winners):** Hesam Farahmand (Iran) & Tõnis Pill (Estonia)
 
• **Best Debut Director – Indian Feature Film:** Karan Singh Tyagi (Kesari Chapter 2)
 
• **Best Web Series (OTT):** Bandish Bandits Season 2
 
• **ICFT-UNESCO Gandhi Medal:** Safe House (Norwegian film)
 
 
 
• **Special Recognition**__
 __
 
• Legendary Indian actor **Rajinikanth** was honoured for completing **50 years** in Indian cinema.
 
 
 
• **About IFFI**__
 
 
• Held annually in Goa, the festival celebrates outstanding contributions to global and Indian cinema.
 
• Recognised as one of Asia’s most prestigious international film festivals.
